_note: Named-practitioner review. Written by hand, deliberately: this is the one claim on the site no script can derive. It was recorded batch by batch while review was in progress; on 6 October 2026 the reviewer confirmed he had read the whole work, so the two scoped entries were replaced by a single full-corpus entry. If review ever narrows again, go back to scoped entries rather than editing this one, because a credit on a page nobody read is the exact dishonesty /reviewers/ exists to prevent.
